reports.title: FY2024 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP
key_findings: 757 UAP reports received in FY2024
118 cases resolved to prosaic causes
Majority of unresolved cases lack sufficient data for resolution
Transmedium cases — objects moving between air, sea, space — flagged as priority
No evidence of extraterrestrial origin in any resolved case

reports.title: AARO Historical Record Report Vol. 1
key_findings: No verifiable evidence of non-terrestrial intelligence or extraterrestrial craft in US government holdings
Many historical sightings correlate with classified US program activity
Misidentification of advanced US programs accounts for a significant portion of historical reports
Persistent stigma reduced reporting quality throughout Cold War era
Structured data collection only began systematically post-2021

reports.title: Preliminary Assessment: UAP (ODNI)
key_findings: 144 reports from US government sources 2004–2021
80 reports involved observation with multiple sensors
18 incidents described unusual movement: stationary winds, sudden direction changes, extreme speed
11 reports of near-misses with US aircraft
Most could not be identified due to limited data

reports.title: PURSUE Portal Initial Release — war.gov/ufo
key_findings: 162 files released May 8 2026 — first tranche of rolling declassification
Covers eyewitness testimony, photos, and reports dating back decades
757 total UAP reports received by AARO in recent reporting period
Files span FBI, DoD, NASA, and State Department records
Additional tranches to be released every few weeks
